title: Canonical differential decomposition for a simple transcendental extension
statement: Let k → F₀ → F be a tower of fields. Let m = 1 and y : Fin m → F consist of transcendental elements over F₀, and suppose IntermediateField.adjoin F₀ (range y) = top. There exists an F-linear equivalence (F tensor over F₀ Ω[F₀/k]) × (Fin m → F) ≃ Ω[F/k] carrying (x,c) to the canonical differential base-change map of x plus the sum of c_j d(y_j). No finite basis of Ω[F₀/k] is assumed. Differentials and their canonical derivation are as in [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]; transcendence is the negation of [def-weil-algebraic-element].

source.place: Tags 00RX (polynomial basis), 00RT (localization), 00RS (differential sequence), and 00S2 (Jacobi–Zariski); smoothing.tex Tag 07FI, transcendental case.

proof.text: Since m = 1, algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff gives algebraic independence. Its aevalEquiv identifies P = F₀[X_j] with A = F₀[y_j]. The adjoin hypothesis and mem_adjoin_iff_div show that every element of F is a fraction from A; IsFractionRing.of_field and of_ringEquiv_left make F a fraction field of P. Localization is formally étale, so transport the scalar extension of mvPolynomialBasis through tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale to give a relative basis brel_j = D F₀ F (y_j).

Mathlib Algebra.FormallySmooth.of_algebraicIndependent makes F/F₀ formally smooth. Hence H₁(L_{F/F₀}) is zero. Apply Mathlib Algebra.H1Cotangent.exact_δ_mapBaseChange and LinearMap.injective_iff_eq_zero_of_exact to show u = mapBaseChange k F₀ F is injective. These are applications of proved Mathlib theorems, with no library proof hole.

Let v = map k F₀ F F and s(c) = sum_j c_j D k F(y_j). The map_D formula and the relative basis expansion give v(s(c)) = brel.equivFun.symm(c). The first exact differential sequence gives v(u(x)) = 0 and ker v = range u. Therefore f(x,c) = u(x) + s(c) is injective by first determining c through v, then x through u. For ω, choose c = brel.equivFun(v(ω)); exactness gives x with u(x) = ω − s(c), which proves surjectivity. LinearEquiv.ofBijective f is the required equivalence; its formula is definitional.

proof_origin.place: Tags 00RX, 00RT, 00RS and 00S2, with the fraction-field construction patterned on the proved library module Sheaf.FieldTheory.SeparablyGeneratedDifferentialsBasis. All tools in this proof are already proved in Mathlib.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_simple_transcendental_differential_decomposition
    (k : Type u) (F₀ : Type v) (F : Type w) [Field k] [Field F₀] [Field F]
    [Algebra k F₀] [Algebra k F] [Algebra F₀ F] [IsScalarTower k F₀ F]
    (m : ℕ) (y : Fin m → F) (hm : m = 1)
    (hy : ∀ j, Transcendental F₀ (y j))
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin F₀ (Set.range y) = ⊤) :
    ∃ E : ((F ⊗[F₀] KaehlerDifferential k F₀) × (Fin m → F)) ≃ₗ[F]
        KaehlerDifferential k F,
      ∀ (x : F ⊗[F₀] KaehlerDifferential k F₀) (c : Fin m → F),
        E (x, c) = mapBaseChange k F₀ F x + ∑ j, c j • D k F (y j)
